subject: data/JANUS-PRECOGNITIVE-SEMANTIC-RETURN-GATE-v0.1.json

suite_summary.interpretation: v0.1 cryptographic identity logic was sound but methodological timing/selection/RNG/commitment gates were incomplete; v0.2 rejects all injected attacks.

redteam_findings.finding: v0.1 can false-accept a negative-J record produced by a clock step/timestamp integrity failure because same_local_clock alone does not prove clock integrity.
redteam_findings.fix: require clock_integrity_valid, monotonic_counter_valid, no_clock_step_in_window and independent_time_anchor_valid

redteam_findings.finding: v0.1 does not explicitly prevent choosing a matching candidate post hoc from many pre-SEND records.
redteam_findings.fix: freeze a single preregistered candidate slot before target assignment; preserve all null records

redteam_findings.finding: independent CSPRNG wording is insufficient unless seed/entropy independence from the tested channel and candidate record is audited.
redteam_findings.fix: require rng_independence_audited; preferably dual independent entropy sources or externally committed randomness

redteam_findings.finding: hash validity alone does not prove the commitment existed before assignment.
target-dependent decoding can reintroduce post-selection even when raw bytes are preserved.
redteam_findings.fix: freeze decoder/parser before the run and require target_independent_decoding

epistemic_boundary: Synthetic/red-team validation demonstrates gate behavior only. It is not evidence for tachyons, FTL, precognition or physical retrocausality.
